body:
User asked (verbatim, via coordinator brief): "for sftp, ftp and webdav do NOT implement (another agent is testing those packages) — list them in your report for a follow-up" and "Leave sftp, ftp, webdav and contrib/crypt for the follow-up and list them."

Context:
  Files: adapters/sftp, adapters/ftp, adapters/webdav, contrib/crypt/crypt.go (forwarded())
  Conversation thread: CO-15/16 (Disk.MakeDir/DirExists, Capabilities.Dirs, DirMaker) and the SweepAbandoned dry run (Disk.FindAbandoned, AbandonedFinder, Capabilities.FindAbandoned) shipped 2026-10-08 in core, local, memory, s3, azure and jobs.

Acceptance:
  sftp/ftp/webdav implement AbandonedFinder from the same scan as SweepAbandoned (staging files, Kind staging) and DirMaker (real directories), declare FindAbandoned and Dirs, conformance cases FindAbandonedKeepsObjects/MakeDir pass; contrib/crypt forwards FindAbandoned and Dirs.

Implementation notes:
  Without Dirs, the Disk's portable DeletePrefix leaves empty directories on these servers; with Dirs, decide whether their Delete prunes like local.
title: FindAbandoned and Dirs for sftp, ftp, webdav; forward both in contrib/crypt
